accounts.title: Accounts

summary.fullnessFull: Per-month data status: empty, transactions present, balance-chain break, or uncategorized correcting entries.
summary.incomeCountFull: Share of income transactions (excluding transfers between own accounts) that have at least one category. Counted by transaction count — answers: “how many income txns have I tagged?”
summary.expenseCountFull: Share of expense transactions (excluding transfers between own accounts) that have at least one category. Counted by transaction count — answers: “how many expense txns have I tagged?”
summary.incomeAmountFull: Share of income by amount: σ category coverage ÷ total income for the month (excluding transfers between own accounts). Partial coverage counts proportionally.
summary.expenseAmountFull: Share of expenses by amount: σ category coverage ÷ total expenses for the month (excluding transfers between own accounts). Partial coverage counts proportionally.
summary.tooltipNoData: No transactions of the matching direction for this month

accounts.legendTitle: How to read the monthly activity
accounts.legendIntro: Each cell is one month. The fill colour reflects how complete the data is for that month; the border encodes special states.

legendItems.preAccount: Month before the account existed — the cell is empty.
legendItems.complete: Transactions exist for this month — data is present.
legendItems.anchored: Later transactions exist, so the chain continues past this month. The current month never gets this border.
legendItems.error: A transaction's balance in this month doesn't match the previous one — the chain is broken.
legendItems.dashed: Uncategorized correcting entries are present in this month and should be reviewed.

accounts.deleteConfirm: Delete account “{name}”? All its transactions and import batches will be removed permanently.
accounts.exportHint: Export this account's transactions to a standard CSV. Edit the counterparty, bank description and comment columns in Excel, then upload the file back below to apply the changes in bulk.
accounts.exportRangeHint: Defaults to the whole period. Clear both fields to export everything.
accounts.exportNoRows: No transactions in the selected range.
accounts.updateSectionHint: Upload a CSV in the same format as the export — a full snapshot of the descriptive fields. Each row is matched to an existing transaction by date, amounts and balance, and its counterparty, bank description and comment are overwritten from the row, including blanks (an empty cell clears the value). Amounts and dates are never modified, no new import is created.
accounts.detailsBatchDeleteConfirm: Delete this import? All of its transactions will be removed.

cash.empty: No entries yet. Add the first one manually.
cash.errorAmountRequired: Fill in either income or expense.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.tableDeltaTitlePercent: Δ — deviation from the dictionary rate as a percentage. Click to switch to absolute values.
transactions.tableDeltaTitleAbsolute: Δ — deviation in each side's currency. Click to switch to a percentage.
transactions.linkPendingTitle: Pick the second transaction or click again to cancel
transactions.linkLinkedTitle: Internal transfer — click to break the link
transactions.linkPickPartner: Pick the second transaction (different account, opposite direction).
transactions.linkUnlinkConfirmText: These transactions will stop counting as an internal transfer and will be included in reports again.

link.txn_not_found: Transaction not found. Refresh the page.
link.same_txn: Can't link a transaction to itself.
link.same_account: Can't link transactions on the same account.
link.same_direction: Linked transactions must be one incoming and one outgoing.
link.already_linked: This transaction is already part of another link.

withdrawal.source_not_outgoing: Withdraw to cash is only available for outgoing transactions.
withdrawal.account_not_cash: Selected account is not a cash account.
withdrawal.invalid_amount: Amount must be a positive number.
withdrawal.rate_unavailable: No exchange rate available for this date.

transactions.withdrawRateUnavailable: No exchange rate for this date — enter the amount manually.
transactions.empty: No transactions match the selected filters.

categories.pickerEmptyIncome: No income categories yet. Create one on the Categories tab.
categories.pickerEmptyExpense: No expense categories yet. Create one on the Categories tab.
categories.exampleOff: Mark as an example for the agent

bulk.confirmIntro: This will set a category on the {count} selected transaction(s). The action cannot be undone.
bulk.markExamples: Mark as examples for the agent ✨
bulk.groupAutomatedHint: Algorithms and models: the outcome is probabilistic and worth checking

bulkDocs.title: Document matching
bulkDocs.intro: For the selected transactions ({count}): recognise linked slips, and where there is none, find a document within ±5 minutes and link it automatically when exactly one matches the amount and direction. Notes from the slips will appear in the AI column.
bulkDocs.local: Recognition uses the method from Settings (local PaddleOCR by default; about 2–3 seconds per slip).

outcome.ambiguous: Several documents fit — link by hand
outcome.no_match: Documents nearby, but no amount match

period.monthsHint: Click — one month; a second click — up to that month
period.monthsHintSecond: Pick the last month of the range (can be in another year)

transactions.tableNoteTitle: Comment or the note from the slip; click to link a document or write a comment
transactions.tableSuggestionTitle: What to do with the transaction: withdrawal to cash, transfer between own accounts or a category; click for the rationale and to apply
transactions.tableContextTitle: What was going on in life on the transaction day (the Context screen)
transactions.tableExampleTitle: Examples for the agent: ✨ — the agent sees this transaction as an example of how you categorise. Click ✨ on a categorised transaction to mark or unmark it.
transactions.splitHandle: Drag to give the width to Suggestion or Category. Double-click resets.

import.title: Import transactions
import.hintKasikorn: Upload the K-DEPOSIT export (resultFile_*.csv) as-is — the account-info header is skipped automatically. Date and time are in Thailand local time; the UTC offset comes from the field above (defaults to +07:00 for the Kasikorn preset).
import.hintKasikornPdf: Upload the PDF statement from K PLUS / Statement Request. The file is usually encrypted — the password is the account owner's date of birth as DDMMYYYY (e.g. 07081988). Credit/debit direction is inferred from balance change between rows.
import.pastePlaceholder: Paste CSV content here — same columns as the file
import.orPasteHere: OR paste the file contents here:
import.hintColumns: Expected columns: occurred_at, credit, debit, balance, peer, bank_description, comment. Required: occurred_at and balance; the rest may be empty. Supported delimiters: comma, tab, semicolon. Date in ISO-8601 with offset (e.g. 2026-04-01T10:15:00+03:00) or without offset — the default will apply.
import.previewFilterEmpty: No rows match the selected issue.

issue.duplicate_db: Duplicate of an existing DB row
issue.duplicate_file: Duplicate of an earlier row in this file
issue.balance_db: Mismatch with DB ({expected} → {actual}). A correcting entry will be added.
issue.balance_file: Gap in file ({expected} → {actual}). A correcting entry will be added.

skipNotice.one: {count} duplicate will be skipped on import
skipNotice.other: {count} duplicates will be skipped on import

import.resultCorrections: Additionally inserted {count} correcting entries to close balance gaps.

categories.title: Categories
categories.fieldDescriptionPlaceholder: Short note: what falls under this category
categories.deleteConfirm: Delete category “{name}”? All its subcategories will be removed permanently.

examples.hint: The agent categorises transactions after your own. For each category it sees every example you marked ✨ (however many), and when there are fewer than {n} it tops up to {n} with recent categorised ones; plus up to 5 earlier transactions of the same counterparty. This shows where examples may not be enough. Mark examples here or on the Transactions screen: the ✨ column, Actions ▾ for a selection.
examples.autoOff: Automatic examples are off (Settings → AI): the agent sees only the ones marked ✨.

help.no_examples: No categorised transactions: the agent knows this category only by its name and description.
help.few_examples: Fewer categorised transactions than the agent can show ({n}). Categorise a few more.
help.agent_misses: The agent suggested another category for these. Mark ✨ the ones typical for this category — the agent will see them as examples.
help.conflicts: These counterparties' transactions are in different categories, and the model cannot tell them apart by the counterparty. Mark ✨ a typical one here — ideally one whose note explains the difference.

examples.agentFalse: {count} more times the agent suggested this category where it was another one or the suggestion was dismissed.

categories.systemHint: A system category: the app marks transfers between own accounts and cash withdrawals with it. Name, colour and description can be changed; it cannot be deleted or moved under another category.

demo.title: Demo data
demo.hint: Replaces all current data with a demo set: a single USD account, a family budget category tree, ~800 transactions over 3 years, and a saved "Отчёт учёта" report.
demo.confirm: All your accounts, categories, transactions, and reports will be deleted permanently and replaced with the demo set. Continue?

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.hint: Deletes all your accounts, categories, transactions, and reports — permanently. After clearing, demo data will no longer appear automatically.
dangerZone.confirm: All your accounts, categories, transactions, and reports will be deleted permanently. Continue?

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.hint: Download a ZIP copy of your data or restore from a previously saved backup. The ZIP contains only finances.db (with a WAL checkpoint applied) — that's all you need for a full restore.
backup.restoreConfirmText: Your current data will be renamed to finances.db.bak-<timestamp> in the same directory. The DB from the archive will be installed in its place and the app will restart. Continue?

errorCodes.backup.no_db: finances.db was not found in the current data directory.
errorCodes.restore.missing_db_in_zip: The archive does not contain finances.db.
errorCodes.restore.invalid_sqlite: The finances.db file in the archive does not open as a valid SQLite database.
errorCodes.restore.no_schema_migrations: The archive has the wrong schema — schema_migrations table is missing.

dataDir.title: Data directory
dataDir.hint: Where finances.db and its WAL files live. Defaults to the standard macOS app directory. You can pick any other folder (e.g. inside iCloud Drive or an external drive). The app restarts after switching.
dataDir.envHint: The path is fixed by the FINANCES_DATA_DIR environment variable. The UI switcher is disabled — change the variable and restart the app instead.
dataDir.confirmTitle: Switch to the new data folder?
dataDir.confirmText: The app will restart. If the target folder already contains finances.db it will be opened; otherwise an empty DB will be created. Your existing data stays where it is, untouched. New path: {path}
dataDir.resetConfirmText: The app will restart and use: {path}

errorCodes.set_data_dir.env_override: Path is locked by the FINANCES_DATA_DIR environment variable — UI switch is disabled.
errorCodes.set_data_dir.write_pointer: Failed to write the data-dir pointer.
errorCodes.set_data_dir.commit_pointer: Failed to commit the data-dir pointer.

ai.title: LLM connections
ai.hint: Connections are created from presets: OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter or any endpoint of your own (e.g. Ollama on your own box — then slip notes never leave your machines).
ai.apiKeyHint: Use "env:NAME" to read the key from an environment variable (recommended) instead of storing it. A literal key is saved unencrypted in the local database.
ai.empty: No connections yet — add one from a preset below.
ai.apiKeyOptional: not needed for a local server
ai.keyProblem: The key is not available: {message}. Open “Edit” and paste the key.

currencies.empty: No exchange rates downloaded yet. Create an account in any currency — rates will be downloaded automatically.
currencies.baseHint: Rates are stored as "1 EUR = X {code}" (Frankfurter base is EUR).

recognition.title: Document recognition
recognition.hint: How slips and receipts are read by “Match documents” and “Recognise”.
recognition.engineLocal: Local — PaddleOCR (default, nothing leaves the computer)
recognition.llmWarning: Document images will be sent to this address. If it is a cloud service, your slips (names, account numbers, notes) leave the computer. For fully local use, run Ollama on your own machine.
recognition.modelHint: The model must understand images (vision), e.g. Qwen2.5-VL.
recognition.rerunHint: Switching the method does not re-read documents already processed — use “Recognise” on a document for that.

agent.title: Category agent
agent.hint: Suggests one category per transaction via “Actions ▾ → Suggest categories”. It learns from your examples: per category, the transactions you starred, topped up with recent categorised ones when there are fewer than the set number.
agent.cloudWarning: This is a cloud provider: transaction descriptions, your notes, slip notes and your “Life context → Context” text go to it. The balance is never sent.
agent.instructionsHint: In your own words — how you categorise. The app adds the category list, the examples and the answer format itself.
agent.minConfidence: Suggest only with confidence of at least (0–10)
agent.minConfidenceHint: The agent suggests a category only for obvious cases. Where it is not sure (confidence below the threshold, or no category named), the Suggestion column shows an “agent not sure” mark with the reason. Its guess is kept: lower the threshold and the guesses that reach it become suggestions at once, without asking the model again. It is not asked again until the examples or the transaction's notes change; “Ask again” in the run dialog asks those too.
agent.autoExamples: When fewer are starred, top up to this number with recent categorised transactions (all starred ones always go in)
agent.usageEmpty: The agent has not been called yet.
agent.exportLogHint: Every model call (what was sent and received, tokens) and every decision of yours about suggestions — for evals.

transaction.title: Transaction
transaction.undatedDocuments: Documents with no known time: {count} — they will show up here once recognised.
transaction.commentHint: What this is — for you and for categorisation
transaction.showLinkedElsewhere: Also show documents linked to other transactions

errors.unknownDelimiter: Could not determine column delimiter in the header. Supported: comma, tab, semicolon.
errors.binaryNotSupported: This format only accepts text files — binary input is not supported.
errors.textNotSupported: This format only accepts binary files — text input is not supported.
errors.pdfPasswordRequired: PDF is encrypted — enter the password and try again.

documents.title: Documents
documents.reportSummary: Files processed: {total}. Added: {added}, already present: {duplicates}, skipped: {skipped}.
documents.emptyHint: Drop slips, receipts or a ZIP archive (e.g. a Google Drive download) here — or click to pick files.
documents.dropHint: Files and ZIPs can be dropped anywhere on the page

selection.confirm: Delete the selected documents ({count})? The files are removed from storage, their links to transactions are dropped and their slip notes disappear from the Note column. Transaction comments stay.

queue.pending: Recognising documents in the background: {count} left. Linking to transactions starts once the whole batch is recognised.
queue.linked: Latest automatic linking: documents linked to outgoing transactions — {count}.
queue.ambiguous: Documents with several candidates — {count}: link them by hand (filter “Several candidates”).
queue.pauseHint: Finish the current document and stop
queue.pausedByUser: Recognition is paused: {count} left. Automatic linking waits too.

documents.notRecognisedYet: Queued for recognition — it runs in the background right after upload.
documents.deleteConfirm: Delete this document? The file is removed from the app's storage; the upload history entry stays.
documents.notLinkedHint: Not linked. Link it from the transaction card — the “Link document” button.
documents.linkHereHint: Not linked. “Link” below links it to this transaction.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.cashHint: A {amount} credit will be created on the cash account and linked with this transaction.

error.not_found: Suggestion not found — reload the page
error.not_pending: The suggestion was already applied or dismissed
error.already_categorized: The transaction already has categories — the suggestion is not applied

run.nothingApplied: Nothing is applied — suggestions appear in the Suggestion column, you apply them.
run.redo: Recompute the ones that already have a suggestion ({count})

cash_withdrawal.title: Find cash withdrawals
cash_withdrawal.intro: Among the selected transactions ({count}) find cash withdrawals (ATM, bank counter) and suggest a new linked transaction on the cash account for each.

transfer.title: Find transfers between accounts
transfer.intro: For the selected transactions ({count}) find the other side on another own bank account: same amount and currency, opposite direction, at most 5 minutes apart.

category.title: Suggest categories
category.intro: For the selected transactions ({count}) the model suggests a category only when it is sure; the rest is left to you without a suggestion. Categorised and linked ones are skipped.
category.noConnection: No connection selected for the agent — Settings → AI.
category.redo: Ask again also where there is a suggestion already ({count}) or the agent was not sure
category.keyProblem: The agent's connection cannot work — {message}. Settings → AI: paste the key or pick another connection for the agent.

run.includeDismissed: Also run the ones dismissed earlier ({count})

skip.not_bank_debit: not a debit on a bank account
skip.no_signal: does not look like a cash withdrawal
skip.no_cash_account: no cash account in this currency
skip.not_confident: the agent is not sure — marked in the Suggestion column

suggestions.unsureHint: The agent suggests no category — it is yours to decide. “Dismiss” removes the mark.

accept.title: Accept suggestions
accept.none: The selected transactions have no suggestions to accept.
accept.intro: Suggestions on the selected transactions: {count}. Choose the confidence to accept from.
accept.pickLevel: Accept with confidence of at least {level}
accept.hint: Suggestions are applied exactly like the “Apply” button: a category is set, a transfer is linked, a cash withdrawal creates the cash transaction. A transfer counts once per pair. “Agent not sure” marks are never applied.

context.hint: What was going on in life: trips, illnesses, guests… Intervals may overlap. A day's events are shown next to transactions and help the agent suggest a category.
context.fieldTitlePlaceholder: e.g. “Trip to Phuket with the kids”
context.fieldNotePlaceholder: Details that help remember the spending

error.ends_before_starts: The interval ends before it starts
error.not_found: Context not found — reload the page

description.hint: Describe your life now in your own words: where you live, what you do, who is in the family and their names, hobbies, what names and abbreviations in your notes mean. The category agent gets this text with every transaction, so it knows who is who in notes like “Masha swimming”. If the agent's connection is a cloud one, the text goes to that provider.
description.placeholder:
For example:
We have lived in Lisbon since 2023; I work remotely.
Family: wife Olya; kids Masha (10) and Petya (6).
Masha goes swimming, Petya plays football. Olya and I play tennis.
Grandma sometimes pays for holidays — that is her gift.
JOAO SILVA is Masha's tutor.
